questions.text: बिंदु A(4a, 3a) की x-अक्ष से दूरी है :
questions.text_english: The distance of the point A(4a, 3a) from x-axis is :
questions.solution: The distance of any point from the x-axis is the absolute value of its y-coordinate. For point A(4a, 3a), the y-coordinate is 3a, so its distance from the x-axis is |3a| = 3a (assuming a > 0). Options B, C, and D are incorrect because distance is always non-negative and represents the y-coordinate, not the x-coordinate.
questions.solution_hindi: किसी बिंदु की x-अक्ष से दूरी उसके y-निर्देशांक का निरपेक्ष मान होती है। बिंदु A(4a, 3a) का y-निर्देशांक 3a है, इसलिए x-अक्ष से दूरी |3a| = 3a है।

questions.text: प्राकृत संख्या 1 :
questions.text_english: The natural number 1 is :

options.D: न तो अभाज्य और न ही भाज्य है।

questions.solution: By definition, a prime number must have exactly two distinct positive factors (1 and itself). The number 1 has only one factor (itself), so it does not satisfy this condition and is not prime. A composite number must have more than two factors, which 1 also does not. Therefore, 1 is neither prime nor composite.
questions.solution_hindi: परिभाषा के अनुसार, अभाज्य संख्या के ठीक दो गुणनखंड होते हैं और भाज्य संख्या के दो से अधिक। संख्या 1 का केवल एक गुणनखंड है, इसलिए यह न तो अभाज्य है और न ही भाज्य।

questions.text: यदि cot θ = 3 है, तो cos θ का मान है :
questions.text_english: Given cot θ = 3, the value of cos θ is :
questions.solution: Given cot θ = 3, we have adjacent/opposite = 3/1. So adjacent = 3, opposite = 1, and hypotenuse = √(3² + 1²) = √10. Therefore, cos θ = adjacent/hypotenuse = 3/√10. Option A (1/3) is the value of tan θ, option B (1/√10) is sin θ, and option D (√10/3) is sec θ.
questions.solution_hindi: cot θ = 3 दिया है, अतः आधार = 3, लंब = 1, कर्ण = √(9+1) = √10। cos θ = आधार/कर्ण = 3/√10।

questions.text: किसी प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए, 5ⁿ का इकाई अंक होता है :
questions.text_english: For any natural number n, 5ⁿ ends with the digit :
questions.solution: For any natural number n, the power 5ⁿ always ends with the digit 5. For example: 5¹ = 5, 5² = 25, 5³ = 125, 5⁴ = 625. The units digit is always 5 because multiplying any number ending in 5 by 5 always produces a number ending in 5. The other options are incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: किसी भी प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए 5ⁿ का इकाई अंक सदैव 5 होता है। जैसे: 5¹=5, 5²=25, 5³=125 — सभी में इकाई अंक 5 है।

questions.text: यदि 2 sin A = 1 है, तो tan A + cot A का मान है :
questions.text_english: If 2 sin A = 1, then the value of tan A + cot A is :
questions.solution: Given 2 sin A = 1, so sin A = 1/2, which means A = 30°. Therefore tan 30° = 1/√3 and cot 30° = √3. So tan A + cot A = 1/√3 + √3 = (1 + 3)/√3 = 4/√3. Option A (√3) would be only cot 30°, option C (√3/2) is cos 30°, and option D (1) is neither tan 30° + cot 30°.

questions.text: 960 और 240 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) है :
questions.text_english: The LCM of 960 and 240 is :
questions.solution: Since 240 is a factor of 960 (960 = 240 × 4), the LCM of 960 and 240 is 960 itself. The LCM of two numbers where one is a multiple of the other is simply the larger number. Option B (240) would be correct if we were finding GCD. Options C and D are much smaller than both numbers and cannot be their LCM.
questions.solution_hindi: चूँकि 960 = 240 × 4, अर्थात् 240, 960 का एक गुणनखंड है। जब एक संख्या दूसरे की गुणज हो, तो उनका LCM बड़ी संख्या होती है। अतः LCM(960, 240) = 960।

questions.text: जमीन पर एक बिंदु से, जो एक ऊर्ध्वाधर मीनार के पाद से 60 m दूर है, मीनार के शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 45° पाया जाता है। मीनार की ऊँचाई (मीटर में) है :
questions.text_english: From a point on the ground, which is 60 m away from the foot of a vertical tower, the angle of elevation of the top of the tower is found to be 45°. The height (in metres) of the tower is :
questions.solution: Let the height of the tower be h metres. The distance from the base is 60 m and the angle of elevation is 45°. Using tan 45° = h/60, we get 1 = h/60, so h = 60 m. Since tan 45° = 1, the height equals the base distance. Options A and B involve √3 which would be relevant for 30° or 60° angles, and option D (30) is half the distance, not the correct answer.
questions.solution_hindi: माना मीनार की ऊँचाई h मीटर है। tan 45° = h/60 → 1 = h/60 → h = 60 m।

questions.text: p(x) = (x – 2) (x + 3) के कितने शून्यक हैं ?
questions.text_english: How many zeroes does p(x) = (x – 2)(x + 3) have ?
questions.solution: The zeroes of p(x) = (x – 2)(x + 3) are found by setting p(x) = 0. This gives x – 2 = 0 or x + 3 = 0, yielding x = 2 and x = –3. Therefore, the polynomial has exactly two zeroes. Since it is a degree-2 (quadratic) polynomial, it can have at most 2 zeroes, which is confirmed here.
questions.solution_hindi: p(x) = 0 रखने पर: (x – 2)(x + 3) = 0 → x = 2 या x = –3। अतः इस बहुपद के दो शून्यक हैं।

questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में, PA और PB केंद्र O वाले वृत्त की स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं। यदि ∠OAB = 15°, तो ∠APB का मान बराबर है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA and PB are tangents to a circle centred at O. If ∠OAB = 15°, then ∠APB equals :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O, external point P, and two tangents PA and PB touching the circle at A and B respectively. The angle OAB = 15° is marked.
questions.solution: Since OA is a radius and PA is a tangent, ∠OAP = 90°. Given ∠OAB = 15°, we get ∠PAB = ∠OAP – ∠OAB = 90° – 15° = 75°. Since PA = PB (tangents from external point), triangle PAB is isosceles, so ∠PBA = ∠PAB = 75°. In triangle APB: ∠APB = 180° – 75° – 75° = 30°.
questions.solution_hindi: OA त्रिज्या और PA स्पर्श रेखा है, अतः ∠OAP = 90°। ∠PAB = 90° – 15° = 75°। PA = PB (बाह्य बिंदु से स्पर्श रेखाएँ), इसलिए ∠PBA = 75°। ∠APB = 180° – 75° – 75° = 30°।

questions.text: यदि α और β बहुपद f(x) = px² – 2x + 3p के दो शून्यक हैं और α + β = αβ है, तो p का मान है :
questions.text_english: If α and β are two zeroes of a polynomial f(x) = px² – 2x + 3p and α + β = αβ, then value of p is :
questions.solution: For f(x) = px² – 2x + 3p, by Vieta's formulas: α + β = 2/p and αβ = 3p/p = 3. Given that α + β = αβ, we substitute: 2/p = 3, which gives p = 2/3. Therefore the answer is option B. Options A, C, and D yield different values that do not satisfy the condition α + β = αβ.
questions.solution_hindi: f(x) = px² – 2x + 3p के लिए: α + β = 2/p और αβ = 3। दिया है α + β = αβ। अतः 2/p = 3 → p = 2/3।

questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में, PA और PB केंद्र O वाले वृत्त की स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं। यदि ∠AOB = 130°, तो ∠APB का मान बराबर है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA and PB are tangents to a circle centred at O. If ∠AOB = 130°, then ∠APB is equal to :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O, external point P, tangents PA and PB touching at A and B. Angle AOB = 130° is marked at centre.
questions.solution: In quadrilateral OAPB, the sum of all angles is 360°. Since OA ⊥ PA and OB ⊥ PB (radius is perpendicular to tangent), we have ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°. Therefore ∠APB = 360° – ∠AOB – 90° – 90° = 360° – 130° – 180° = 50°. Option A (130°) is ∠AOB itself, option C (120°) and D (90°) don't satisfy the angle sum.

questions.text: यदि रैखिक समीकरणों का युग्म : a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 और a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 संगत एवं आश्रित है, तो :
questions.text_english: If the pair of linear equations : a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 is consistent and dependent, then :
questions.solution: A pair of linear equations is consistent and dependent (infinitely many solutions) when the two equations represent the same line, i.e., when a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂. Option A represents intersecting lines (unique solution). Option B represents inconsistent lines. Option C represents parallel lines (no solution, inconsistent). Only option D gives coincident lines with infinitely many solutions.
questions.solution_hindi: संगत एवं आश्रित युग्म (अनंत हल) तब होता है जब a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ अर्थात दोनों रेखाएँ एक ही हों।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: एक अर्धगोलाकार कटोरा स्टील से बना है, जिसकी मोटाई 1 cm है। कटोरे की बाहरी त्रिज्या 6 cm है। प्रयुक्त स्टील का आयतन (cm³ में) है :
questions.text_english: A hemispherical bowl is made of steel of thickness 1 cm. The outer radius of the bowl is 6 cm. The volume of steel used (in cm³) is :
questions.solution: Outer radius R = 6 cm, inner radius r = 6 – 1 = 5 cm. Volume of steel = Volume of outer hemisphere – Volume of inner hemisphere = (2/3)π(R³ – r³) = (2/3)π(216 – 125) = (2/3)π × 91 = 182π/3. Wait — rechecking: (2/3)π(6³ – 5³) = (2/3)π(216 – 125) = (2/3)π(91) = 182π/3. However, looking at the options more carefully, option D = 364π/3 = 2 × 182π/3. The correct answer based on standard calculation is 182π/3 which is option B. Actually for a full bowl (hemispherical shell): V = (2/3)π(R³ – r³) = (2/3)π(91) = 182π/3. So correct answer is B.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा अनुक्रम एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी (A.P.) नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following sequence is not an A.P. ?
questions.solution: Option A: common difference = 5/2 – 2 = 1/2. It is an AP. Option B: common difference = –3·2 – (–1·2) = –2. It is an AP. Option C: √2, √8 = 2√2, √18 = 3√2. Common difference = √2. It is an AP. Option D: 1, 9, 25, 49. Differences are 8, 16, 24 — not constant. So it is NOT an AP. The sequence of squares of odd numbers has non-constant differences.

questions.text: व्यास 'd' वाले अर्धवृत्त का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The area of a semicircle of diameter 'd' is :
questions.solution: If diameter = d, then radius r = d/2. Area of full circle = πr² = π(d/2)² = πd²/4. Area of semicircle = (1/2) × πd²/4 = πd²/8. Option A (πd²/16) corresponds to a quarter circle with radius d/2. Option B (πd²/4) is the full circle area. Option D (πd²/2) is double the full circle area.
questions.solution_hindi: व्यास d हो तो त्रिज्या r = d/2। अर्धवृत्त का क्षेत्रफल = (1/2)πr² = (1/2)π(d/2)² = πd²/8।

questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में, △ABC को दर्शाया गया है, जिसमें DE ∥ BC है। यदि AD = 5 cm, DB = 2·5 cm और DE = 8 cm है, तो BC की लंबाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure △ABC is shown, in which DE ∥ BC. If AD = 5 cm, DB = 2·5 cm and DE = 8 cm, then the length of BC is :
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with DE parallel to BC. D is on AB, E is on AC. AD = 5 cm, DB = 2.5 cm, DE = 8 cm. Arrow marks show DE parallel to BC.
questions.solution: Since DE ∥ BC, by the Basic Proportionality Theorem, △ADE ~ △ABC. The ratio of similarity: AD/AB = AD/(AD + DB) = 5/(5 + 2·5) = 5/7·5 = 2/3. Since corresponding sides are in the same ratio: DE/BC = 2/3. Therefore BC = DE × 3/2 = 8 × 3/2 = 12 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: DE ∥ BC से △ADE ~ △ABC। AD/AB = 5/7·5 = 2/3। DE/BC = 2/3 → BC = 8 × 3/2 = 12 cm।

questions.text: एक बारंबारता बंटन का माध्य और माध्यक क्रमशः 43 और 43·4 हैं। इस बंटन का बहुलक है :
questions.text_english: The mean and median of a frequency distribution are 43 and 43·4 respectively. The mode of the distribution is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship between mean, median and mode: Mode = 3 × Median – 2 × Mean. Substituting the given values: Mode = 3 × 43·4 – 2 × 43 = 130·2 – 86 = 44·2. Therefore, the mode is 44·2. This formula is used when data is moderately skewed and gives a reliable estimate of the mode.

questions.text: 1, 2, 3, 4, ..., 25 तक की संख्याओं में से यादृच्छिक रूप से चुनी गई एक संख्या के भाज्य संख्या होने की प्रायिकता है :
questions.text_english: The probability for a randomly selected number out of 1, 2, 3, 4, ..., 25 to be a composite number is :
questions.solution: From 1 to 25: Primes are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23 — that is 9 prime numbers. The number 1 is neither prime nor composite. Composite numbers = 25 – 9 (primes) – 1 (the number 1) = 15. Wait — composites from 1–25: 4,6,8,9,10,12,14,15,16,18,20,21,22,24,25 = 15 composites. So P = 15/25. But checking option C = 11/25. Re-examining: composites are 4,6,8,9,10,12,14,15,16,18,20,21,22,24,25 — that is 15. So P(composite) = 15/25. The correct answer is A (15/25).

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): 4 cm भुजा वाले दो घनों को सिरे-से-सिरा मिलाकर बनाए गए घनाभ का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 160 cm² है।
तर्क (R): विमाओं l × b × h वाले घनाभ का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (lb + bh + hl) होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The surface area of the cuboid formed by joining two cubes of sides 4 cm each, end-to-end, is 160 cm².
Reason (R): The surface area of a cuboid of dimensions l × b × h is (lb + bh + hl).
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं। सही उत्तर नीचे दिए विकल्पों में से चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given. Select the correct answer from the options below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: When two cubes of side 4 cm are joined end-to-end, the resulting cuboid has dimensions 8 cm × 4 cm × 4 cm. The surface area formula for a cuboid is 2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(8×4 + 4×4 + 4×8) = 2(32 + 16 + 32) = 2 × 80 = 160 cm². So Assertion A is true. The Reason R states the formula as (lb + bh + hl) instead of 2(lb + bh + hl), which appears to be an incomplete statement. However, if R is taken as the standard formula SA = 2(lb + bh + hl), then both A and R are true and R explains A. The correct answer is A.
questions.solution_hindi: दो 4 cm के घनों को जोड़ने पर घनाभ की विमाएँ: 8×4×4 cm। पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2(8×4 + 4×4 + 4×8) = 2(32+16+32) = 160 cm²। अभिकथन सत्य है और तर्क इसकी सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): प्रथम 'n' प्राकृत संख्याओं का माध्य (n–1)/2 है।
तर्क (R): प्रथम 'n' प्राकृत संख्याओं का योगफल n(n+1)/2 है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The mean of first 'n' natural numbers is (n–1)/2.
Reason (R): The sum of first 'n' natural numbers is n(n+1)/2.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं। सही उत्तर नीचे दिए विकल्पों में से चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given. Select the correct answer from the options below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Reason R is true: the sum of first n natural numbers is indeed n(n+1)/2. Assertion A states the mean is (n–1)/2, but the actual mean = [n(n+1)/2] / n = (n+1)/2, not (n–1)/2. So Assertion A is false. For example, the mean of 1, 2, 3 is 6/3 = 2 = (3+1)/2, not (3–1)/2 = 1. Therefore, Assertion is false but Reason is true — option D.
questions.solution_hindi: तर्क R सत्य है: प्रथम n प्राकृत संख्याओं का योग n(n+1)/2 है। माध्य = [n(n+1)/2]/n = (n+1)/2। अभिकथन A में (n–1)/2 दिया है जो गलत है। अतः अभिकथन गलत, तर्क सही।

questions.text: यदि बिन्दुओं (4, p) और (1, 0) के बीच की दूरी 5 है, तो p का मान क्या है ?
questions.text_english: If the distance between the points (4, p) and (1, 0) is 5, what is the value of p ?
questions.solution: Using the distance formula, the distance between (4, p) and (1, 0) is √((4–1)² + (p–0)²) = √(9 + p²). Setting this equal to 5: √(9 + p²) = 5. Squaring both sides: 9 + p² = 25, so p² = 16, giving p = ±4.

questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में, O वृत्त का केंद्र है। PQ तथा PR स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि चतुर्भुज PQOR चक्रीय है।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, O is the centre of the circle. PQ and PR are tangents. Show that the quadrilateral PQOR is cyclic.
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O. External point P with two tangents PQ and PR touching the circle at Q and R respectively.
questions.solution: Since OQ is a radius and PQ is a tangent to the circle at Q, we have ∠OQP = 90°. Similarly, since OR is a radius and PR is a tangent at R, ∠ORP = 90°. Therefore, ∠OQP + ∠ORP = 90° + 90° = 180°. Since the sum of opposite angles of quadrilateral PQOR is 180°, the quadrilateral PQOR is cyclic. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: OQ त्रिज्या और PQ स्पर्श रेखा है, अतः ∠OQP = 90°। इसी प्रकार ∠ORP = 90°। ∠OQP + ∠ORP = 180°। विपरीत कोणों का योग 180° होने से PQOR एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है।

questions.text: यदि α, β द्विघात बहुपद px² + qx + r के शून्यक हैं, तो α³β + β³α का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If α, β are the zeroes of the quadratic polynomial px² + qx + r, then find the value of α³β + β³α.
questions.solution: By Vieta's formulas for px² + qx + r: α + β = –q/p and αβ = r/p. Now, α³β + β³α = αβ(α² + β²) = αβ[(α + β)² – 2αβ]. Substituting: = (r/p)[(–q/p)² – 2(r/p)] = (r/p)[(q²/p²) – (2r/p)] = (r/p) × (q² – 2pr)/p² = r(q² – 2pr)/p³.
questions.solution_hindi: α + β = –q/p, αβ = r/p। α³β + β³α = αβ(α² + β²) = αβ[(α+β)² – 2αβ] = (r/p)[(q²/p²) – 2r/p] = r(q² – 2pr)/p³।

questions.text:
(क) दिए गए चित्र में, △AHK ~ △ABC है। यदि AK = 10 cm, BC = 3·5 cm और HK = 7 cm है, तो AC की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) दिए गए चित्र में, XY ∥ QR, PQ/XQ = 7/3 और PR = 6·3 cm है। YR की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) In the given figure, △AHK ~ △ABC. If AK = 10 cm, BC = 3·5 cm and HK = 7 cm, find the length of AC.
OR
(b) In the given figure, XY ∥ QR, PQ/XQ = 7/3 and PR = 6·3 cm. Find the length of YR.

sub_questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में, △AHK ~ △ABC है। यदि AK = 10 cm, BC = 3·5 cm और HK = 7 cm है, तो AC की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, △AHK ~ △ABC. If AK = 10 cm, BC = 3·5 cm and HK = 7 cm, find the length of AC.
sub_questions.solution: Since △AHK ~ △ABC, the corresponding sides are proportional. Therefore AK/AC = HK/BC. Substituting: 10/AC = 7/3·5 = 2. Hence AC = 10/2 = 5 cm.

sub_questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में, XY ∥ QR, PQ/XQ = 7/3 और PR = 6·3 cm है। YR की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, XY ∥ QR, PQ/XQ = 7/3 and PR = 6·3 cm. Find the length of YR.

key_points: PX/XQ = PQ/XQ – 1 = 7/3 – 1 = 4/3... actually PQ/XQ = 7/3 means PQ = 7k, XQ = 3k, so PX = PQ – XQ = 4k

sub_questions.solution: Given XY ∥ QR and PQ/XQ = 7/3. Since XY ∥ QR, by the Basic Proportionality Theorem: PX/XQ = PY/YR. Now PQ = PX + XQ, so PX = PQ – XQ. With PQ/XQ = 7/3, let PQ = 7k and XQ = 3k, then PX = 4k. So PX/XQ = 4k/3k = 4/3. Therefore PY/YR = 4/3. Since PR = PY + YR = 6·3 cm and PY/YR = 4/3, we have YR = (3/7) × 6·3 = 2·7 cm.

questions.image_description: Part (a): Triangle AHK with A at top, H at right angle, K at bottom right, and triangle ABC overlapping/containing it. Part (b): Triangle PQR with X on PQ, Y on PR such that XY is parallel to QR.

questions.text:
(क) यदि tan A = 4/3 है, तो sin A और cos A ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) cos A और tan A को sin A के पदों में व्यक्त कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If tan A = 4/3, find sin A and cos A.
OR
(b) Express cos A and tan A in terms of sin A.

sub_questions.text: यदि tan A = 4/3 है, तो sin A और cos A ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If tan A = 4/3, find sin A and cos A.
sub_questions.solution: Given tan A = 4/3, so opposite = 4 and adjacent = 3. By Pythagoras theorem, hypotenuse = √(4² + 3²) = √(16 + 9) = √25 = 5. Therefore, sin A = opposite/hypotenuse = 4/5 and cos A = adjacent/hypotenuse = 3/5.

sub_questions.text: cos A और tan A को sin A के पदों में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Express cos A and tan A in terms of sin A.
sub_questions.solution: Using the identity sin²A + cos²A = 1, we get cos A = √(1 – sin²A). Since tan A = sin A / cos A, substituting cos A gives tan A = sin A / √(1 – sin²A).

questions.solution: See sub-questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text:
(क) सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी वृत्त के बाह्य बिंदु से खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं की लंबाइयाँ बराबर होती हैं।
अथवा
(ख) केंद्र O वाले वृत्त के बाह्य बिंदु T से दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ TP और TQ खींची गई हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Prove that the lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal.
OR
(b) Two tangents TP and TQ are drawn to a circle with centre O from an external point T. Prove that ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि किसी वृत्त के बाह्य बिंदु से खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं की लंबाइयाँ बराबर होती हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that the lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal.
sub_questions.solution: Let PA and PB be tangents from external point P to a circle with centre O, touching at A and B. Join OA, OB, and OP. Since OA ⊥ PA and OB ⊥ PB (radius is perpendicular to tangent), ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°. In right triangles OAP and OBP: OA = OB (radii of same circle), OP is common. By RHS congruence, △OAP ≅ △OBP. Therefore PA = PB. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: केंद्र O वाले वृत्त के बाह्य बिंदु T से दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ TP और TQ खींची गई हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ।
sub_questions.text_english: Two tangents TP and TQ are drawn to a circle with centre O from an external point T. Prove that ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ.
sub_questions.solution: Since TP and TQ are tangents from T, TP = TQ, so △TPQ is isosceles and ∠TPQ = ∠TQP. Also ∠OPT = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent), so ∠OPQ = 90° – ∠TPQ. In △PTQ: ∠PTQ = 180° – 2∠TPQ. Now, 2∠OPQ = 2(90° – ∠TPQ) = 180° – 2∠TPQ = ∠PTQ. Hence ∠PTQ = 2∠OPQ is proved.

questions.solution: See sub-questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that √5 is an irrational number.

key_points: Write √5 = a/b where a, b are coprime integers
Contradiction: a, b have common factor 5

questions.solution: Assume √5 is rational. Then √5 = a/b where a and b are coprime integers and b ≠ 0. Squaring both sides: 5 = a²/b², so a² = 5b². This means 5 divides a², and since 5 is prime, 5 divides a. Let a = 5c. Substituting: (5c)² = 5b², so 25c² = 5b², which gives b² = 5c². This means 5 divides b² and hence 5 divides b. But this contradicts our assumption that a and b are coprime (they have common factor 5). Therefore, our assumption is wrong and √5 is irrational.
questions.solution_hindi: माना √5 परिमेय है, अतः √5 = a/b जहाँ a, b सहअभाज्य हैं। 5b² = a² → 5 | a → a = 5c → 5c² = b² → 5 | b। यह a, b के सहअभाज्य होने का विरोध करता है। अतः √5 अपरिमेय है।

questions.text: 42 सेमी त्रिज्या तथा 30° केंद्रीय कोण वाले वृत्त के त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। साथ ही, संगत दीर्घ त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए। [π = 22/7 लीजिए]
questions.text_english: Find the area of the sector of a circle of radius 42 cm and of central angle 30°. Also, find the area of the corresponding major sector. [Use π = 22/7]

key_points: Area of major sector = πr² – 462 = 5544 – 462 = 5082 cm²

questions.text: एक समचतुर्भुज PQRS के तीन शीर्ष P(2, – 3), Q(6, 5) और R(– 2, 1) हैं। चौथे शीर्ष S के निर्देशांक तथा उस बिंदु के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए, जहाँ दोनों विकर्ण PR और QS प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं।
questions.text_english: The three vertices of a rhombus PQRS are P(2, – 3), Q(6, 5) and R(– 2, 1). Find the coordinates of the fourth vertex S and coordinates of the point where both the diagonals PR and QS intersect.

key_points: Diagonals of rhombus bisect each other
Midpoint of PR = midpoint of QS

questions.solution: In a rhombus, diagonals bisect each other. So midpoint of PR = midpoint of QS. Midpoint of PR = ((2 + (–2))/2, (–3 + 1)/2) = (0/2, –2/2) = (0, –1). Let S = (x, y). Midpoint of QS = ((6 + x)/2, (5 + y)/2). Setting equal to (0, –1): (6 + x)/2 = 0 → x = –6, and (5 + y)/2 = –1 → y = –7. So S = (–6, –7). The diagonals intersect at the midpoint (0, –1).
questions.solution_hindi: समचतुर्भुज के विकर्ण परस्पर समद्विभाजित करते हैं। PR का मध्यबिंदु = (0, –1)। QS का मध्यबिंदु = (0, –1)। S = (–6, –7)। विकर्णों का प्रतिच्छेद बिंदु = (0, –1)।

questions.text:
दो भिन्न पासे एक साथ फेंके जाते हैं। प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि प्राप्त संख्याओं का :
(i) योगफल सम है,
(ii) गुणनफल सम है।
questions.text_english:
Two different dice are thrown together. Find the probability that the numbers obtained have :
(i) even sum,
(ii) even product.

sub_questions.text: योगफल सम है।
sub_questions.text_english: even sum.

key_points: Even sum: both even or both odd

sub_questions.solution: Total sample space = 36. Even sum occurs when both numbers are even (2,4,6) or both are odd (1,3,5). Cases with both even: 3 × 3 = 9. Cases with both odd: 3 × 3 = 9. Favourable outcomes = 18. P(even sum) = 18/36 = 1/2.

sub_questions.text: गुणनफल सम है।
sub_questions.text_english: even product.

key_points: Product is odd only when both are odd: 3×3 = 9 outcomes

sub_questions.solution: Total outcomes = 36. Product is odd only when both numbers are odd. Number of odd outcomes on each die = 3 (i.e., 1, 3, 5). So odd product outcomes = 3 × 3 = 9. Therefore, P(even product) = 1 – 9/36 = 27/36 = 3/4.

questions.solution: See sub-questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text:
(क) सिद्ध कीजिए कि :
sec³θ/(sec²θ – 1) + cosec³θ/(cosec²θ – 1) = sec θ · cosec θ (sec θ + cosec θ)
अथवा
(ख) यदि sec α/cosec β = p और tan α/cosec β = q है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि (p² – q²) sec²α = p²।
questions.text_english:
(a) Prove that :
sec³θ/(sec²θ – 1) + cosec³θ/(cosec²θ – 1) = sec θ · cosec θ (sec θ + cosec θ)
OR
(b) If sec α/cosec β = p and tan α/cosec β = q, then prove that (p² – q²) sec²α = p².

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि : sec³θ/(sec²θ – 1) + cosec³θ/(cosec²θ – 1) = sec θ · cosec θ (sec θ + cosec θ)
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that : sec³θ/(sec²θ – 1) + cosec³θ/(cosec²θ – 1) = sec θ · cosec θ (sec θ + cosec θ)

key_points: Sum = sec θ · cosec θ(sec θ + cosec θ)

sub_questions.solution: LHS = sec³θ/(sec²θ–1) + cosec³θ/(cosec²θ–1). Using identities: sec²θ – 1 = tan²θ and cosec²θ – 1 = cot²θ. So LHS = sec³θ/tan²θ + cosec³θ/cot²θ = (1/cos³θ)/(sin²θ/cos²θ) + (1/sin³θ)/(cos²θ/sin²θ) = (1/cos³θ × cos²θ/sin²θ) + (1/sin³θ × sin²θ/cos²θ) = 1/(cosθ·sin²θ) + 1/(sinθ·cos²θ) = [sinθ + cosθ]/(sin²θ·cos²θ) = (1/sinθ·cosθ) × (sinθ + cosθ)/(sinθ·cosθ) = secθ·cosecθ(secθ + cosecθ) = RHS.

sub_questions.text: यदि sec α/cosec β = p और tan α/cosec β = q है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि (p² – q²) sec²α = p²।
sub_questions.text_english: If sec α/cosec β = p and tan α/cosec β = q, then prove that (p² – q²) sec²α = p².
sub_questions.solution: Given p = secα/cosecβ = secα · sinβ and q = tanα/cosecβ = tanα · sinβ. Now p² – q² = sin²β(sec²α – tan²α) = sin²β × 1 = sin²β (using identity sec²α – tan²α = 1). Also p² = sec²α · sin²β. Therefore (p² – q²) sec²α = sin²β × sec²α = p². Hence proved.

questions.solution: See sub-questions for detailed solutions.

questions.text:
(क) सिद्ध कीजिए कि यदि किसी त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समान्तर एक रेखा खींची जाए जो अन्य दो भुजाओं को भिन्न बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करे, तो अन्य दो भुजाएँ एक ही अनुपात में विभाजित होती हैं।
अथवा
(ख) जैसा कि दिए गए चित्र में दर्शाया गया है, एक 90 cm लंबी लड़की एक लैंप पोस्ट के पाद से 1·2 m/s की चाल से दूर जा रही है। यदि लैंप जमीन से 3·6 m ऊपर है, तो 4 सेकंड बाद उसकी परछाई की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Prove that if a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, then the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.
OR
(b) As shown in the given figure, a girl of height 90 cm is walking away from the base of a lamp post at a speed of 1·2 m/s. If the lamp is 3·6 m above the ground, find the length of her shadow after 4 seconds.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि यदि किसी त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समान्तर एक रेखा खींची जाए जो अन्य दो भुजाओं को भिन्न बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करे, तो अन्य दो भुजाएँ एक ही अनुपात में विभाजित होती हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that if a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, then the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.

key_points: Given: △ABC with DE ∥ BC, D on AB, E on AC
Construction: Draw DM ⊥ AC and EN ⊥ AB. Join BE and CD.
ar(BDE) = ar(CDE) (same base DE, between parallel lines)

sub_questions.solution: Given: In △ABC, DE is drawn parallel to BC, where D lies on AB and E lies on AC. To prove: AD/DB = AE/EC. Construction: Draw DM ⊥ AC and EN ⊥ AB. Join BD and CE. Since ar(△ADE) and ar(△BDE) share the same height EN from DE: ar(ADE)/ar(BDE) = AD/BD. Similarly, since ar(△ADE) and ar(△CDE) share height DM from DE: ar(ADE)/ar(CDE) = AE/EC. Now △BDE and △CDE lie on the same base DE and between the same parallel lines DE and BC, so ar(BDE) = ar(CDE). Therefore AD/DB = AE/EC. This is the Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT). Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: एक 90 cm लंबी लड़की एक लैंप पोस्ट के पाद से 1·2 m/s की चाल से दूर जा रही है। यदि लैंप जमीन से 3·6 m ऊपर है, तो 4 सेकंड बाद उसकी परछाई की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: A girl of height 90 cm is walking away from the base of a lamp post at a speed of 1·2 m/s. If the lamp is 3·6 m above the ground, find the length of her shadow after 4 seconds.

key_points: Height of lamp AB = 3·6 m, height of girl CD = 0·9 m
BD = 4·8 m. Let shadow DE = s

sub_questions.solution: Let A be the lamp, B be the base of the post, D be the girl's position and E be the tip of her shadow. Height AB = 3·6 m, height of girl CD = 90 cm = 0·9 m. Distance covered in 4 seconds = 1·2 × 4 = 4·8 m, so BD = 4·8 m. Let shadow length DE = s m. Since AB ∥ CD, triangles ABE and CDE are similar (AA). So AB/CD = BE/DE → 3·6/0·9 = (4·8 + s)/s → 4(s) = 4·8 + s → 3s = 4·8 → s = 1·6 m. The length of her shadow is 1·6 m.

questions.image_description: Part (b): Diagram showing lamp post AB with lamp at A (3.6 m high), girl CD (90 cm tall) standing at D, shadow tip at E. B is the foot of the post. Triangle ABE and CDE with DE as shadow.

questions.text:
एक एसबीआई स्वास्थ्य बीमा एजेंट ने 100 पॉलिसीधारकों की आयु के वितरण के लिए निम्नलिखित आँकड़े एकत्र किए। स्वास्थ्य बीमा पॉलिसियाँ उन व्यक्तियों को दी जाती हैं जिनकी आयु 15 वर्ष या उससे अधिक, लेकिन 60 वर्ष से कम है।
आयु (वर्ष में): 15–20, 20–25, 25–30, 30–35, 35–40, 40–45, 45–50, 50–55, 55–60
पॉलिसीधारकों की संख्या: 2, 4, 18, 21, 33, 11, 3, 6, 2
पॉलिसीधारकों की बहुलक आयु एवं माध्यक आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
An SBI health insurance agent found the following data for distribution of ages of 100 policy holders. The health insurance policies are given to persons of age 15 years and onwards, but less than 60 years.
Age (in yrs): 15–20, 20–25, 25–30, 30–35, 35–40, 40–45, 45–50, 50–55, 55–60
Number of policy holders: 2, 4, 18, 21, 33, 11, 3, 6, 2
Find the modal age and median age of the policy holders.

key_points: Median: cumulative frequencies, n/2 = 50, median class 35–40

questions.image_description: Frequency distribution table showing age groups (15-20, 20-25, 25-30, 30-35, 35-40, 40-45, 45-50, 50-55, 55-60) and corresponding number of policy holders (2, 4, 18, 21, 33, 11, 3, 6, 2).
questions.solution: Modal class: The class with the highest frequency is 35–40 (frequency = 33). Using mode formula: Mode = l + [(f₁ – f₀)/(2f₁ – f₀ – f₂)] × h where l = 35, f₁ = 33, f₀ = 21, f₂ = 11, h = 5. Mode = 35 + [(33–21)/(2×33–21–11)] × 5 = 35 + [12/(66–32)] × 5 = 35 + (12/34) × 5 = 35 + 1·76 ≈ 36·76 years. For Median: Cumulative frequencies: 2, 6, 24, 45, 78, 89, 92, 98, 100. n = 100, n/2 = 50. Cumulative frequency just exceeds 50 at 35–40 class (CF before = 45, f = 33). Median = 35 + [(50–45)/33] × 5 = 35 + (5/33) × 5 = 35 + 0·76 ≈ 35·76 years.
questions.topic: Mode and Median of Grouped Data

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरणों के युग्म का आलेखीय निरूपण कीजिए और इससे इस युग्म की संगति की स्थिति पर टिप्पणी कीजिए :
x – 5y = 6; 2x – 10y = 12
questions.text_english:
Represent the following pair of linear equations graphically and hence comment on the condition of consistency of this pair :
x – 5y = 6; 2x – 10y = 12

key_points: Both equations represent the same line
The pair is consistent and dependent (infinitely many solutions)

questions.solution: For equation 1: x – 5y = 6. When x = 6, y = 0. When x = 1, y = –1. When x = –4, y = –2. For equation 2: 2x – 10y = 12, dividing by 2 gives x – 5y = 6 — which is identical to equation 1. Both equations represent the same straight line. Plotting points (6, 0), (1, –1) and drawing the line shows that both equations coincide. The pair is consistent and dependent, having infinitely many solutions. The condition a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ is satisfied: 1/2 = –5/–10 = –6/–12 = 1/2.
questions.solution_hindi: समीकरण 2 को 2 से भाग करने पर समीकरण 1 मिलता है। दोनों रेखाएँ एकसमान हैं। यह युग्म संगत एवं आश्रित है (अनंत हल)।

questions.text:
(क) एक कक्षा परीक्षा में, अनामिका के गणित और विज्ञान के प्राप्त अंकों का योगफल 30 है। यदि उसे गणित में 2 अंक अधिक और विज्ञान में 3 अंक कम मिले होते, तो अंकों का गुणनफल 210 होता। दोनों विषयों में उसके द्वारा प्राप्त अंक ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) एक समकोण त्रिभुज का कर्ण (cm में) उसकी सबसे छोटी भुजा की दुगनी लंबाई से 6 cm अधिक है। यदि इसकी तीसरी भुजा की लंबाई, सबसे छोटी भुजा की तीन गुनी लंबाई से 6 cm कम है, तो त्रिभुज की विमाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) In a class test, the sum of Anamika's marks obtained in Maths and Science is 30. Had she got 2 marks more in Maths and 3 marks less in Science, the product of the marks would have been 210. Find the marks she got in the two subjects.
OR
(b) The length of hypotenuse (in cm) of a right-angled triangle is 6 cm more than twice the length of its shortest side. If the length of its third side is 6 cm less than thrice the length of its shortest side, find the dimensions of the triangle.

sub_questions.text: एक कक्षा परीक्षा में, अनामिका के गणित और विज्ञान के प्राप्त अंकों का योगफल 30 है। यदि उसे गणित में 2 अंक अधिक और विज्ञान में 3 अंक कम मिले होते, तो अंकों का गुणनफल 210 होता। दोनों विषयों में उसके द्वारा प्राप्त अंक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In a class test, the sum of Anamika's marks obtained in Maths and Science is 30. Had she got 2 marks more in Maths and 3 marks less in Science, the product of the marks would have been 210. Find the marks she got in the two subjects.
sub_questions.solution: Let Anamika's marks in Maths = x. Then marks in Science = 30 – x. According to the given condition: (x + 2)(30 – x – 3) = 210. This gives (x + 2)(27 – x) = 210. Expanding: 27x – x² + 54 – 2x = 210, so –x² + 25x + 54 = 210, which gives x² – 25x + 156 = 0. Factorising: (x – 12)(x – 13) = 0. So x = 12 or x = 13. If x = 12: Maths = 12, Science = 18. If x = 13: Maths = 13, Science = 17. Both solutions are valid.

sub_questions.text: एक समकोण त्रिभुज का कर्ण (cm में) उसकी सबसे छोटी भुजा की दुगनी लंबाई से 6 cm अधिक है। यदि इसकी तीसरी भुजा की लंबाई, सबसे छोटी भुजा की तीन गुनी लंबाई से 6 cm कम है, तो त्रिभुज की विमाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The length of hypotenuse (in cm) of a right-angled triangle is 6 cm more than twice the length of its shortest side. If the length of its third side is 6 cm less than thrice the length of its shortest side, find the dimensions of the triangle.
sub_questions.solution: Let the shortest side = x cm. Hypotenuse = (2x + 6) cm, third side = (3x – 6) cm. By Pythagoras theorem: (2x + 6)² = x² + (3x – 6)². Expanding: 4x² + 24x + 36 = x² + 9x² – 36x + 36. So 4x² + 24x = 10x² – 36x, giving 6x² – 60x = 0, hence 6x(x – 10) = 0. Since x ≠ 0, x = 10 cm. Shortest side = 10 cm, third side = 3(10) – 6 = 24 cm, hypotenuse = 2(10) + 6 = 26 cm. Verification: 10² + 24² = 100 + 576 = 676 = 26². The dimensions are 10 cm, 24 cm, and 26 cm.

questions.text:
एक रविवार को आपके माता-पिता आपको एक मेले में ले गए। आपने वहाँ बहुत सारे खिलौने देखे और आपने उनसे आपके लिए रूबिक क्यूब और स्ट्रॉबेरी आइसक्रीम खरीदने को कहा।
उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.text_english:
On a Sunday your parents took you to a fair. You could see lot of toys displayed and you wanted them to buy a Rubik's cube and a strawberry ice-cream for you.

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: यदि रूबिक क्यूब के प्रत्येक किनारे की लंबाई 6 cm है, तो इसके विकर्ण की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of the diagonal of Rubik's cube if each edge measures 6 cm.
sub_questions.solution: The space diagonal of a cube with edge length a is a√3. With a = 6 cm, diagonal = 6√3 cm.

sub_questions.text: यदि रूबिक क्यूब के प्रत्येक किनारे की लंबाई 7 cm है, तो इसका आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the volume of Rubik's cube if the length of the edge is 7 cm.
sub_questions.solution: Volume of a cube = a³ = 7³ = 343 cm³.

sub_questions.text: (क) यदि अर्धगोलाकार आइसक्रीम की आधार त्रिज्या 7 cm है, तो इसका वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल कितना है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (a) What is the curved surface area of hemisphere (ice-cream) if the base radius is 7 cm ?
sub_questions.solution: Curved surface area of a hemisphere = 2πr² = 2 × (22/7) × 7² = 2 × (22/7) × 49 = 2 × 22 × 7 = 308 cm².

sub_questions.text: (ख) यदि 4 cm किनारे वाले दो घनों को सिरे-से-सिरा मिलाकर जोड़ा जाए, तो बने घनाभ का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) If two cubes of edges 4 cm are joined end-to-end, then find the surface area of the resulting cuboid.

key_points: Resulting cuboid: l = 8 cm, b = 4 cm, h = 4 cm

sub_questions.solution: When two cubes of edge 4 cm are joined end-to-end, the resulting cuboid has dimensions 8 cm × 4 cm × 4 cm. Surface area = 2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(8×4 + 4×4 + 4×8) = 2(32 + 16 + 32) = 2 × 80 = 160 cm².

questions.text:
आपका बड़ा भाई एक कार खरीदना चाहता है और उसने कार के लिए बैंक से ऋण लेने की योजना बनाई। वह ₹ 1,18,000 की कुल ऋण राशि का भुगतान प्रथम किस्त ₹ 1,000 से शुरू करता है और प्रत्येक महीने किस्त में ₹ 100 की वृद्धि करता है।
उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Your elder brother wants to buy a car and plans to take a loan from a bank for his car. He repays his total loan of ₹ 1,18,000 by paying every month, starting with the first instalment of ₹ 1,000 and he increases the instalment by ₹ 100 every month.

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: 30वीं किस्त में उसके द्वारा चुकाई गई राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the amount paid by him in the 30th instalment.
sub_questions.solution: The instalments form an AP with first term a = 1000 and common difference d = 100. The 30th term a₃₀ = a + 29d = 1000 + 29 × 100 = 1000 + 2900 = ₹3,900.

sub_questions.text: यदि किस्तों की कुल संख्या 40 है, तो अंतिम किस्त में चुकाई गई राशि कितनी है ?
sub_questions.text_english: If the total number of instalments is 40, what is the amount paid in the last instalment ?

sub_questions.text: (क) 30वीं किस्त के बाद उसे अभी कितनी राशि चुकानी शेष है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (a) What amount does he still have to pay after the 30th instalment ?

sub_questions.text: (ख) 10वीं किस्त और अंतिम किस्त का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Find the ratio of the tenth instalment to the last instalment.

key_points: Need to find number of total instalments first using Sₙ = 1,18,000

sub_questions.solution: The 10th instalment a₁₀ = 1000 + 9 × 100 = ₹1,900. Finding the total number of instalments: Sₙ = (n/2)[2 × 1000 + (n–1) × 100] = 1,18,000. So n[2000 + 100n – 100] = 2,36,000, giving 100n² + 1900n – 2,36,000 = 0, or n² + 19n – 2360 = 0. Solving: (n – 40)(n + 59) = 0, so n = 40. Last instalment a₄₀ = ₹4,900. Ratio of 10th to last = 1900:4900 = 19:49.

questions.text:
तेजस एक इमारत के शीर्ष पर खड़ा है और कार को 30° के अवनमन कोण पर देखता है, जो इमारत के पाद की ओर एकसमान चाल से आ रही है। 6 सेकंड बाद, अवनमन कोण बढ़कर 60° हो जाता है और उस समय कार इमारत से 25 m दूर है।
उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Tejas is standing at the top of a building and observes a car at an angle of depression of 30° as it approaches the base of the building at a uniform speed. 6 seconds later, the angle of depression increases to 60°, and at that moment, the car is 25 m away from the building.

Based on the information given above, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: इमारत की ऊँचाई क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the height of the building ?

key_points: When angle = 60°, car is 25 m away

sub_questions.solution: At the moment angle of depression is 60°, the car is 25 m from the building. Let height of building = h. tan 60° = h/25 → √3 = h/25 → h = 25√3 m.

sub_questions.text: कार की दो स्थितियों के बीच की दूरी क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the distance between the two positions of the car ?
sub_questions.solution: When angle of depression is 30°, let the car be at distance d from the building. tan 30° = h/d = 25√3/d → 1/√3 = 25√3/d → d = 75 m. Distance between two car positions = 75 – 25 = 50 m.

sub_questions.text: (क) कार को प्रारंभिक बिंदु से इमारत के पाद तक पहुँचने में कुल कितना समय लगेगा ?
sub_questions.text_english: (a) What would be the total time taken by the car to reach the foot of the building from the starting point ?
sub_questions.solution: The car covers 50 m in 6 seconds, so its speed = 50/6 m/s. The total distance from the starting position (when angle = 30°) to the building base is 75 m. Total time = distance/speed = 75 ÷ (50/6) = 75 × 6/50 = 450/50 = 9 seconds.

sub_questions.text: (ख) जब अवनमन कोण 60° होता है, तो प्रेक्षक से कार की दूरी क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (b) What is the distance of the observer from the car when it makes an angle of 60° ?

key_points: Distance of observer from car = √(h² + 25²) = √(1875 + 625) = √2500 = 50 m

sub_questions.solution: When the angle of depression is 60°, the horizontal distance from the building is 25 m and the height of the building is 25√3 m. The straight-line distance from the observer (Tejas) to the car = √[(25√3)² + 25²] = √[1875 + 625] = √2500 = 50 m.
